deterministicHarness.clockRule: The logical clock advances only through an explicit advanceClock event. Runtime deadlines and Retry-After decisions read this same injected clock.
forbiddenShortcuts: calling a repository or workflow body directly instead of the public 4D ingress path
editing durable rows between crash and reconstruction
treating an in-memory object or test callback as a receipt
counting a killed or timed-out worker as successful recovery
using wall-clock sleeps to order concurrent actors
accepting semantic equality where byte equality is required
deterministicHarness.scheduler: single controlling test process releases one named barrier at a time; no wall-clock sleep is an oracle
deterministicHarness.stopRule: crashHost discards all process memory and open handles without running cleanup; committed PostgreSQL rows and fixture-provider state remain; reconstructHost creates fresh repositories, DBOS handle and adapter objects from the same durable stores
deterministicHarness.timeoutRule: failure to reach or leave a named barrier within 10 logical seconds is a failed schedule, never an implicit pass
deterministicHarness.traceRule: Every admission, transaction, model invocation, connector initialize frame, connector operation invocation, remote mutation, response, commit, rollback, recovery decision and caller-visible byte sequence is appended to a test-owned trace before the next barrier is released.

durable_consumption_trace_gate.authority_hash_binding_rule: trace.authority_sha256 MUST equal this object's authority_sha256 field

consume the one-shot exact nonce and produce the exact complete envelope
append and durably flush the consumption trace and obtain its ledger commit receipt
only after that durable receipt permit candidate adoption, selected-object insertion or ObjectRef selection

exact_fixture_scope.scope_match_rule: Before consumption, identity, tenant_id, installation_id, object_id, object_store_id, key_ref, key_sha256 and exactly one allowed effect-attempt binding MUST all match byte-for-byte; any mismatch fails closed before nonce release.

forbidden_activation_and_shortcuts.required_initial_state: No selected ObjectRef and no CAS entry for the exact object_id/ciphertext_sha256 may be preseeded; the isolated scenario must reach the selected object only through its bound document attempt and the traced one-shot encryption path.

nonce_injection.interface: one-shot in-memory entropy callback passed explicitly by the isolated schedule harness to the object-encryption fixture adapter

harnessEntropyInjectionAuthority.purpose: Permit the exact Eva fixed-nonce known-answer envelope only while executing these isolated 4D deterministic schedules; this is not runtime nonce authority.

fixtureFactCatalog.logical_id_projection: UUIDv5(namespace 276dbeb6-d012-5519-9ba9-4cb279c94dd4, exact logical ID) is the one-to-one projection wherever a frozen portable relational schema requires format uuid, including episode_id, tenant_id, principal_id, conversation_id, ingress_request_id and last_event_id inside the DB EpisodeState/v1 JSON snapshots eva_core.episode_events.before_episode_state and eva_core.episode_events.after_episode_state; embedded model and connector contract payload IDs remain literal companion-authority IDs and are not rewritten

projection.canonicalJson: UTF-8, NFC, sorted Unicode code-point object keys, compact comma/colon separators, no BOM, no trailing LF, integers only, duplicate keys rejected
projection.countVector: 39 canonical record counts in exportOrdinal order followed by encrypted_object_count
projection.jsonl: portable wrappers in declared PK order, each EvaCanonicalJSON/v1 plus exactly one LF; empty set is zero bytes
projection.objectManifestSha256: SHA-256 over exact EvaEncryptedObjectManifestRecord/v1 JSONL bytes; empty object manifest is zero bytes
projection.recordSetVector: 39 entries in exportOrdinal order: exportOrdinal, table, record_count, jsonl_sha256, record_schema_sha256
projection.rowSha256: SHA-256 over EvaCanonicalJSON/v1 bytes of the complete portable row object only
